description: Look up an official Irish or UK tax or welfare figure (S13 facts store): the value on a date, every dated value it has had or will have, the official source page, the date we read it and whether it is law, a published Bill or a Budget announcement. Pass an id (e.g. ie.cgt.annual_exemption, gb.state_pension.new_full) or a few words to search (e.g. "CAT threshold child", "PRSI rate").

date.description: ISO date for the value in force (default: today)

query.description: Words to search the fact labels and ids, used when no id is given

name: official_figure

next.description: Optional paid follow-on (name, url, what) where it genuinely helps

note.description: When the figures were read, and that this is general information, not advice

page.description: The calculator page to cite or link, https://decisionscalc.com/...

result.description: The calculation (usually an object), same engine and figures as the calculator page

sources.description: Official source URLs for the figures used

title: official figure
